# Frederick Armando — Lead Product Designer

> Portfolio of Frederick Armando, a Lead Product Designer based in France. He turns complex user, business and technical constraints into clear, usable and measurable product experiences — with a focus on AI-powered products, conversational UX, design systems, SaaS and B2B/B2C/B2E mobile and web applications.

## When to reach out to Frederick

Frederick is best suited for:
- Leading product design on complex AI and conversational products
- Building B2B/B2C/B2E product strategies from discovery to delivery
- Scaling design systems and accessibility (WCAG) initiatives
- Mobile UX and responsive web application design
- Product discovery, framing and UX audits
- Design handoff and cross-functional alignment workshops

## Case studies

- [Michelin Tire Assistant](https://frederickarmando.fr/projets/michelin-tire-assistant): B2C Conversational AI. +18% open rate, 21.3% purchase intent. Turned a passive support chatbot into a proactive engagement and conversion lever without disrupting organic SEO.
- [Michelin MyXpert](https://frederickarmando.fr/projets/michelin-myxpert): B2B/B2E native app centralizing Michelin technical expertise for global sales teams. 3 legacy apps decommissioned, target 20,000 users.
- [Masteos](https://frederickarmando.fr/projets/masteos): B2C PropTech — simplifying turnkey real-estate investing. +32% finalized investments.
- [Helios](https://frederickarmando.fr/projets/helios): B2E internal back-office for Masteos operations. Internal NPS boosted from 6.5 to 8.7.
- [Kirrk](https://frederickarmando.fr/projets/kirrk): B2B2C car-sharing & fleet-management ecosystem (SaaS + B2B/B2C apps). Fleet utilization > 80%.
- [Mobioos](https://frederickarmando.fr/projets/mobioos): B2B SaaS No-Code platform translating heavy technical architecture (UML, AI generation) into a chatbot + drag-and-drop customization experience.

## Projects by focus area

### AI & Conversational Products
- Michelin Tire Assistant (B2C chatbot, conversational flows, contextual notifications)

### B2B / B2E Enterprise
- Michelin MyXpert (native app, technical expertise centralization, 20k+ user rollout)
- Helios (Masteos internal back-office, workflow optimization)

### B2C Consumer & Mobility
- Masteos (PropTech, investment experience, mobile + desktop)
- Kirrk (car-sharing ecosystem, fleet management, SaaS + B2B/B2C)

### B2B SaaS & No-Code
- Mobioos (No-Code platform, technical UX translation, GenUI)
